signaldeck_plugin_main.script.help.condi: if and while expect a ConditionCommand. compare compares already resolved values; compare_value reads the left value live from the ValueProvider.
signaldeck_plugin_main.script.help.if.te: if executes its first block when the condition returns true. The optional else block is executed otherwise. The block ends with end.
signaldeck_plugin_main.script.help.set.t: set creates or overwrites a variable in the ExecutionContext. With set <name> = <ValueCommand>, the return value of a ValueCommand can also be stored.
signaldeck_plugin_main.script.help.value: ValueCommands return a value. In the first implementation they may only be used on the right-hand side of set with '='. get_value reads a value from the ValueProvider.
signaldeck_plugin_main.script.help.varia: Variables are referenced with a leading and trailing $. Start parameters and runtime variables created with set use the same syntax.
signaldeck_plugin_main.script.help.while: while repeats its block while the ConditionCommand returns true. For simply waiting for a ValueProvider value, waitFor is usually more efficient and clearer.

signaldeck_plugin_main.script.no_scripts: No script exists yet. Use 'New' to create one.
